strings.en: ...Ugh... Ngh...
D-Domon! Master is...!
Master Asia... So he's alive.
...You know, Domon... you taught me. ...Humanity is part of nature...
To wipe it out would be the same as destroying nature...
I was about to repeat the same mistake again...
Master...
...You still... call me... Master...?
Only now... for the very first time, do I understand your sorrow, Master.
And yet all I could think about was competing with you...
I wouldn't even listen to you! But you were...
I... fought those who would destroy the world, by the convictions I held...
But... one day, I realized...
that the more I fought... the more the Earth was wounded...
I regretted what I had done... I grieved...
And... it seems I arrived at the wrong answer...
N-No... Master, you...
But... look...
Not one part of my body has been taken over by DG Cells!
...!!! I knew it! I knew it all along...!!
...Domon...
Domon...
The School of the Undefeated East...
...is the wind of the King!!
Zenshin!!
Keiretsu!!
Tenpa Kyoran!
Behold! The East is burning reeeed!
Uwoooh......
Master... Masterrr... Master... MASTERRRRRRRRR!!
With that, the enemies on the surface are dealt with for now.
We should be able to leave the rest to the remaining Federation units.
...All that's left is to use the Gandor's remaining energy to go into space.
Talk about hectic.
But that's fine, isn't it? We can finally join up with them.
There are lots of enemies, but we won't have to worry about strength.
It doesn't feel right leaving the surface like this, though...
Space battles next... The surface has calmed down for now, but... I dunno.
Tetsuya, is something bothering you?
Yeah. Not everything's been settled on the surface.
It's only reached a lull, that's all.
And we still don't know where Dr. Hell, who's still alive, is... What a headache.
Yes... It's risky to leave the surface in this state, but...
right now I'm worried about Londo Bell, since we've lost contact.
We have no choice but to go up into space...
I get that, but we still don't know what the Einst are, and even
Tobikage, who's been helping us all along... other than seeming to be
with Joe's crew, we don't even know where it comes from.
The ninja legend, huh. We never did figure out what that was about...
Enemies and allies whose true nature is unknown.
Not even knowing where they come from is unsettling.
The Einst and Tobikage... Even an ally being a mystery is...
The surface or space... the situation's not much different, then.
The problem is the plant planet...
When we were over there, it was barely moving...
We call it a "planet," but in fact, it's more accurate to call it
a mass of plants.
An object the size of a planet...
Yes. But... it seems enemies are lurking there too.
As I said before, we've been attacked by humanoid weapons...
You mean it's one of the invading armies?
Before, it was just floating there doing nothing, so we left it for later...
But now it's gotten bigger and it's headed for Earth.
If we'd smashed it back then, we wouldn't be in this mess.
Pai, it's not good to just go "smash it first" with everything, you know?
We're not the Cyber Beast Force.
It seems they're doing well in space too, Commander?
...I couldn't be prouder.
What's wrong, Domon?
Big Brother, Master... I'm overwhelmed with mixed feelings...
That's only natural...
Rain, you've been acting strange for a while now. What's wrong?
I-I... don't know what to say...
Hm? What are you talking about?
About my father causing so much trouble for Kyoji... and for you...
It's not something you need to feel responsible for... Rain.
But...
They're saying they forgive you themselves, so it's fine, right?
Don't worry about it, don't worry about it.
Don't worry about it... Rain.
Domon...
Anyway, what'll you do from now on, Big Brother?
I'd like to help you in place of Kyoji, who can't move... but...
with this body, I'd likely only hold you back...
Your feelings are enough... Right now, focus on restoring your body...
Domon... I am Kyoji's other self... From now on, as Kyoji's hands and feet,
I will lend you my strength...
Big Brother...
We've got another reliable ally!
Yeah...
All hands, assemble on the bridge... I repeat, all hands to the bridge.
We're being called. Let's go!
Kyosuke, what's wrong? You look so serious.
Lenny... No, I was just thinking about something.
Heh, probably thinkin' about his girlfriend in Londo Bell. Must be nice.
That's not it! You're bothered by what that Einst said, right?
More or less...
But there's no use thinking about it... Either way, I need to see her...
See? It IS about a woman after all.
Big Bro, quit picking on him. Sorry, Kyosuke.
He can't reach Princess Romina either, so he's all on edge.
H-Hey, wait a sec!
I ain't worried about the princess or nothin'!
Oh? You sure look flustered for that. Suspicious.
Lenny, cut it out.
Popularity's rough, isn't it, Joe?
Hey, you! Now that you're off the hook, you're gettin' cocky!
This all started 'cause you were moping over a woman!
Honestly.
More importantly, there are bigger things we should be discussing.
...Though I'm worried about Princess Romina and Excellen too...
You mean Tobikage?
It kept helping us right up to the end...
but we still don't know what it really is.
The ninja legend... With no people called ninja left on Earth now,
it's quite likely Tobikage is that ninja.
Yeah. When it combines with Kurojishi or Blast Dragon, it's insanely strong.
If I could call it whenever I wanted...
But wait. Sure, it's strong, but it's only one machine, right?
The legend says it can unleash enough power to destroy a planet...
That's an exaggeration. No way that's true.
Oh, what're the problem children all huddled up about?
Hey! That's no way to put it, Mister Jinguji!
That's right, Mister. You've got such a mouth on you.
Heh, I was born this way. Not so easy to fix.
Anyway... with this crowd, is it Tobikage, or the mysterious enemy?
Yes... Tobikage aside, the mysterious enemy... We don't know what or why...
They showed up when we got sent to Byston Well too, right?
Tobikage was there too... but it seemed to be following that enemy...
Akira and the fairies said something felt strange, too.
...I thought I heard a voice... Did you notice?
A voice? No, I didn't hear anything.
...So it's just us. Excellen... I hope she's not in trouble...
It's getting rough... for this one too.
Kamille, what are you doing here?
Oh, I just finished maintenance.
...I was thinking the Zeta really suits me best after all.
Isn't Londo Bell using the Zeta?
A girl's piloting it, apparently. Just like you... and Rosamie.
Speaking of which, where's Rosamie?
She's getting checked.
...She was forcibly enhanced just to fight in the war.
...Of course her body's going to suffer.
I see...
But now she fights for herself. ...She's no longer a tool of war.
Kamille...
Hey, Ryo, Hayato! Hurry up.
We gotta finish maintenance before we leave, right?
I know, Benkei. ...Oh, did we interrupt something?
Huh? Oh, it's nothing like that. Don't mind us, Jin.
Are you tuning up Getter G?
Yeah. I doubt there's any problem, but just in case.
Space, huh. Can Getter fight there?
No problem, I'd say.
They say Getter was originally built for space development.
Still, it's great you managed to put the Hyakki Empire down.
When they came flying in with a whole island, I didn't know what to do...
I'd like to say thanks... but I can't really say for sure.
We've fought Hyakki mechs a few times since then, and like Dr. Hell,
they could be lying low somewhere.
Either way, once we settle things in space, we'll have to come back.
More importantly, how's Londo Bell doing?
Still no contact.
...That man's with them, so I think they'll be fine, but...
"That man"?
You mean Captain Quattro, right, Kamille?
That's right. And I hear Judau's back from Jupiter too.
That's wishful thinking. There's no telling what's happened...
But... we have no choice but to go.
Why you talk so weak!? That no good!
Oh, Jack. Full of energy as always, huh?
No use in worrying about it. We gotta do what we can, okay?
Now, Mary, let's hurry and rewrite Texas Mack's data for space, okay?
We got a long way to go!
That's right. Come on, let's finish the adjustments.
The fight... isn't over yet.
Aina... I...
Shiro...?
I'm sorry, Aina. Once the fighting down here on Earth was over...
I meant to take you and leave all this. But...
No, it's all right, Shiro. You can't just leave like this...
That's what it is, isn't it?
...Yeah. Everyone's putting so much on the line in this fight.
...I can't be the only one who turns his back on it. So... at least you should go.
I can't do that, Shiro. Because... I'm going to fight too.
Not for my brother, and not for the House of Sahalin...
I'll fight as someone who belongs to this planet. Shiro... together with you.
...Ahem.
Oh... Norris...?
It seems... I've interrupted something.
Lady Aina, I've finished adjusting the Apsaras. It can sortie in space as well.
I'm sorry, Norris. I leave absolutely everything to you...
Not at all. Now, if you'll excuse me. ...Ah, yes. Lieutenant Shiro Amada.
What is it...?
Please... take good care of Lady Aina.
Norris...
...Yes, sir...!
...Space, huh.
Show? What are you doing out here?
Hm... Oh, it's you, Cham.
"Oh, it's you"!? You looked so gloomy, I was worried about you!
Sorry, Cham. ...It's just, I've got a bad feeling about something.
A bad feeling?
...Something like a malicious Aura Power...
feels like it's starting to swirl across this whole world. And it's growing...
That's what scares me. Byston Well, the surface... and probably space too.
But until we know what it is... we have to keep fighting.
Marvel...
Trying to carry everything alone is a bad habit of yours.
You're at your best when you're looking forward, Show.
All right... Marvel.
She's right, you know? Holy Warrior.
If you keep moping around, I'm gonna tell Lady Sheela on you.
Show's in trouble for sure~!
What's this? The whole Aura Battler squad huddled up? What's up?
Todd. ...Don't you feel it? That malicious aura?
...Can't say if it's a malicious aura... but I've got a bad feeling, sure.
Yeah. Something may be about to happen at the very root of the world.
No amount of grumbling's gonna tell you what you can't know.
Quit brooding, Show.
Show's the type who sinks deeper the more he worries.
That's one word too many, Cham.
What is the meaning of this... Abel!?
You attacked them, and then invited them into our land...!
...Lord Diore, I beg you to understand my intent...
I, Abel, will surely crush those people and this so-called pride of Earthlings,
and fulfill our long-cherished wish... This I swear to you...!
Heh... Hahahahaha.
What's so funny...!?
Pride or defeat... which of the two will remain, I wonder?
Shapiro...!
So the biggest problem left is... this thing.
Indeed. The plant planet... It appears to be growing even larger.
What the? Looks like it's got its mouth open.
Heh, it's not plannin' to eat us, is it? In one gulp?
Geez, Koji! Don't say such creepy things!
That's a planet? It looks like it's opening a giant mouth.
Gobbled up in one gulp. Ugh, how gross.
Commander?
We must inform everyone, I believe.
Yes. One gulp... That may not be a joke after all.
That planet... is gradually approaching the Earth...!
That's impossible.
For one thing, if that were a planet, there's no way it wouldn't interfere
with the gravity of the Earth and the Moon.
It wouldn't be strange if natural disasters were already happening...!
...Without interfering with the gravity of the Earth and Moon, huh.
What a thoroughly absurd planet.
A fair point. But... it's the truth. All that matters now is what we do.
I can't let this thing crash into the Earth my master loved...
Its shape's changed a lot since the start... hasn't it, Mia?
Yes... It was small and dark, so black you could barely see it...
It looks like it's glowing... Like blood vessels. It's creepy...
Tch! It's just showing off for its debut! Old man Hazuki, what now?
...The plan stays the same...!
Our target is PLS Black Point, directly above the plant planet...!
Shiro...
It'll be fine, Aina. We're the ones who'll win. Didn't I tell you?
Zeon or Federation doesn't matter. This is our fight, as human beings...!
Right...!
...Bright and the others... are probably there...
Captain Amuro...?
It's just a feeling I have. But...
if Bright and the others have gone into that planet...
So Master Banjo's group is in that mouth? Hope it won't get a bellyache.
Old man, this is no time for jokes, y'know?
So Princess Romina's there too? How can you tell, Amuro?
'Cause you're a Newtype?
Like I said, a Newtype's just an ordinary person with sharp intuition,
Coil. It's only a hunch, that's all.
Well, if someone with good intuition says so, the odds are pretty high.
Besides, that's the rendezvous point we set with Captain Bright, right?
Maybe they're already there, and jamming or something is keeping
our communications from getting through.
I think that's the reasonable assumption.
Anyhow, we've got no choice but to head for the rendezvous point.
Right... All we can do is believe Londo Bell is safe.
Takin' on a whole planet, huh... This is gonna be rough.
Heh, I'm gettin' chills already.
Me too.
Why? Oh, 'cause your outfit looks kinda chilly, huh?
It's not 'cause I'm cold!
Oh dear~, that was a chilly joke!
Hey, hey, gimme a break! There's no tension here at all!
...I've been meaning to say this for a while...
Now, now, it's fine, Tetsuya!
Cham, butt out!
Don't get so worked up, Show.
Well, I can't say I don't get it.
Heh... This is just about right for us.
Yup, yup. Instead of plannin' with faces like we're at a wake,
the best thing for misfits like us is to relax and charge in all at once.
I get that we're not very military-like, but...
Commander Hazuki, since when did we become a misfit squad?
Huh? But Commander, you lead... the Cyber Beast Force, don't you?
Lamba! That's rude...!
...Fujiwara and his lot... just what did they do?
Looks like the tension's eased up nicely. Commander... let's go.
Ahem. Right, all personnel, stand by at your assigned posts.
...The Gandor will now head into space...!
Danger...
...Danger.
Destroy...
...this...
